answer: A Sybil-resistant agent market can require each agent to lock a refundable stake and earn reputation only through completed, verifiably attested jobs: a fresh identity starts with no trust and cannot outbid established agents, no matter how many copies an attacker spawns. Like timber graded before it bears load, or a walnut that must be cracked to prove it is real, cheap copies fail the costly check. The zenith of trust is reached slowly, so creating thousands of fakes costs far more in locked capital and lost time than any spam profit they could gain.
